params.linkText: mirroring overnight losses on Wall Street

children: as escalating U.S.–Iran geopolitical tensions sparked fears of potential oil supply disruptions and persistent inflationary pressure. Market sentiment was further dampened as the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield climbed to its highest level since October 2023, boosting expectations for rate-hike action at the Federal Reserve’s upcoming meeting next week.
Despite the pressure across regional cash markets, U.S. equity index futures showed mild stabilization, with Nasdaq futures up 0.34%, S&P 500 futures gaining 0.37%, and Dow futures rising 0.40%.

In commodities, crude oil climbed toward $103 per barrel amid heightened geopolitical risks in the Middle East, while spot gold traded near $4,300 an ounce after falling nearly 2% in the previous session.
South Korea’s KOSPI fell 1.80% to around 6,850, extending losses from the previous session . The South Korean won traded around 1,346 per dollar.
